definitions.gloss: looking around restlessly; glancing about nervously
definitions.explanation: Describes the action of repeatedly looking in different directions, typically out of curiosity, confusion, or nervousness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}って→迷う：02426_mayou⟧きょろきょろ⟦{見回|みまわ}した→見回す：05545_mimawasu⟧。
examples.english: I was lost and looked around restlessly.

examples.japanese: きょろきょろ⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}いて→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Stop looking around and face forward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きょろきょろ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見回|みまわ}している→見回す：05545_mimawasu⟧。
examples.english: The tourists are glancing around at their surroundings.

notes:
MIMETIC TYPE:
Onomatopoeia describing eye movement - the sound/feel of eyes darting around.

GRAMMATICAL FORMS:
- きょろきょろ（⟦と→と：00512_to⟧）⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ - to look around restlessly
- きょろきょろ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to glance about (suru-verb)
- きょろきょろ⟦{見回|みまわ}す→見回す：05545_mimawasu⟧ - to look all around

USAGE:
Often implies the person looks uncertain, lost, or unfamiliar with their surroundings. Can have a slightly comic or childlike connotation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちらちら→ちらちら：07407_chirachira⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ - to glance repeatedly (more subtle)
- ⟦じろじろ→じろじろ：06907_jirojiro⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ - to stare intently (rude)
- ⟦うろうろ→うろうろ：05168_urouro⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to wander about aimlessly
